summary.en: Iraqi forces have reached a compromise with the pro-Iran militia Kataib Hezbollah and are deploying a joint security command in Jurf al-Nasr and Jurf al-Sakhar, while Prime Minister Ali al-Zaidi has ordered a new security command in the area. Security officials arrested the oil pipeline chief on smuggling allegations and placed forces on alert as the Jurf al-Sakhar command prepares to start operations on Friday. ISIS remnants faced airstrikes in Anbar province and tribes warned against further security changes, as nearly one million Iraqis registered firearms. The UCDP recorded 396 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

background.extract: The Iraqi conflict is a series of violent events that began with the 2003 American-led invasion of Iraq and deposition of Iraqi dictator Saddam Hussein, followed by a series of conflicts including the protracted Iraq War (2003–2011), the Iraqi insurgency (2011–2013), the War in Iraq (2013–2017), and most recently, the small-scale Islamic State insurgency in 4 provinces located in Northern Iraq since 2017.
